✓ indicates capability support; the catalogue includes runtime-verified and architecture-compatible variants without runtime acceptance.

Images means image understanding. Tools require a compatible native template; the client executes them. Llama 3.2 supports one native custom tool call per turn.

Acceleration requires matching auxiliary weights (see Drafter below); — means unsupported or not yet available. DFlash2 requires Qwen 3.8 27B Affine 4/8-bit, is text-only, and cannot run alongside MTP. See [MTP / Assistant](mtp-server-api.md) and [DFlash2](dflash2-server-api.md).

## Before downloading

Choose a version that fits your memory; context, concurrency, and assistants add to weight memory. FP16/BF16 are unquantized weight types. OptiQ and mixed-bit entries do not use one precision for every layer.
